answer: Require every new agent identity to post a refundable stake, locked until it completes attested tasks and peers verify the work. A raven earns the flock trust by proving it can find food, and a newcomer likewise earns trust gradually. Each task proof is sealed with a cipher challenge only the claimed identity can open, so one operator cannot run thousands in parallel. The verified history then acts as a jetty, a record others can dock against before trading. Faking thousands of identities means funding thousands of stakes and solving thousands of ciphers, a cost that exceeds any gain.
